content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that clears the workspace (L1), loads a depth matrix from depth.txt under a configured folder (L4), forms a 3-by-3 uniform convolution kernel (L8), computes a same-sized convolution (L9), replaces only the matrix interior outside a five-point boundary with the filtered result (L11), and writes new_depth.txt as ASCII (L13).
entities: fdir — folder-prefix workspace variable assigned at L3
dep — loaded depth matrix assigned at L4 and interior-updated at L11
edge — excluded-border width assigned at L6
K — 3-by-3 convolution-kernel matrix assigned at L8
tmp — same-sized convolution result assigned at L9

params_defined.name: fdir
params_defined.range: folder prefix must make concatenated input/output paths valid

equations.ref: replace only the interior submatrix and retain the original edge band

io.name: depth.txt loaded as dep via folder-prefix concatenation
new_depth.txt saved in ASCII format from dep via folder-prefix concatenation

verbatim_spans.text: edge=5; % set edge points you dont want filter

unresolved: L8 constructs nine weights of 0.11111, whose sum is 0.99999 rather than 1; L9 applies that non-unit-sum kernel and L11 installs its result, so even a spatially constant interior is attenuated slightly on each script run.
L3-L4 and L13 rely on fdir already ending with an appropriate path separator; no normalization or existence check is performed before concatenating the two filenames.
